parts.name: native-components
parts.basis: All remaining native topology in one draw group, preserving source positions and scale.

manufacturer-cad.stp.gz.scope: Every native solid/free shell/free face retained once without scaling. Draw-group consolidation does not infer electrical package identity.

dimensionTargets.scope: Native aggregate bounds, not physical fit across assembly revisions.

inspectionGroups.notes: Rigid debug separation of native optical aggregate, not a verified disassembly sequence.

materialBasis: Manufacturer reference photographs guide approximate colors. Materials and undocumented package finishes are visualization only.
assemblyNotes: Millimetres; source geometry is retained without scaling. Source revisions, omitted members and estimated reconstruction boundaries are explicit.
limitations: No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.

Viewing circle follows manufacturer dimension photo:87.60mm for3.4C and101.52mm for4C. Native aggregate front component includes optical/carrier details and is retained intact, not split into fictitious parts.
All native source geometry retained. Current PCB revision, undocumented package identity and material are not inferred from CAD.
No physical button hit target is fabricated without calibration; verified BOOT and touch inputs use product controls. DSI framebuffer remains unsupported on these boards.
